visualReview.observed: Bounded card crops show readable text, clear Close controls and aligned Support/Partnership actions in the captured regions.
visualReview.limitations: External fonts were blocked. Card crops are not a complete page, production visual approval, every keyboard state, or the broader responsive audit.

earlierFailures.reason: Screenshot selector targeted the intentionally hidden public footer after seven passing Terms Close/reload checks.

Last mobile Privacy Escape/focus wait raised a runner error. Snapshot showed correct root/focus/closed overlays and that case alone recorded a blocked script evaluation. Exact error cause remains unproven; DOM locator waits replaced predicate polling without relaxing CSP.

limitations: External fonts, advertising, services, connections and forms are intentionally blocked.
Signed-in, paid-access, backend, inbox, payment and production behavior are outside this check.
Screenshots document the local blocked-network presentation, not production visual acceptance.
No ineffective action is retried; the first action must produce the asserted result.
